title: Center a Card Perfectly
prompt:
Make `.stage` a flex container that centers `.card` both horizontally and vertically, and give `.stage` a `min-height: 100vh` so centering has room.

Rules:
- `display: flex`, `justify-content: center`, `align-items: center` on `.stage`.
boilerplate: <!-- Center the card in the stage -->

tests.name: stage is a flex container
tests.code: if (!/\.stage\s*\{[^}]*display\s*:\s*flex\s*;/i.test(code)) throw new Error("Set display: flex on .stage.");
tests.hint: Flex properties only work on a flex container: display: flex.

tests.name: horizontal centering
tests.code: if (!/\.stage\s*\{[^}]*justify-content\s*:\s*center\s*;/i.test(code)) throw new Error("Center along the main axis with justify-content: center.");
tests.hint: justify-content: center centers items on the main (horizontal) axis.

tests.name: vertical centering with room to center
tests.code:
if (!/\.stage\s*\{[^}]*align-items\s*:\s*center\s*;/i.test(code)) throw new Error("Center the cross axis with align-items: center.");
if (!/\.stage\s*\{[^}]*min-height\s*:\s*100vh\s*;/i.test(code)) throw new Error("Give .stage min-height: 100vh so vertical centering has space.");
tests.hint: align-items: center handles the vertical axis; min-height: 100vh gives it a stage.
